fusions.name: Ringing Plate
fusions.desc: Sends a pulse of sound into the first enemy in its path up to 10 tiles away. It deals 30 resonating damage that ignores armour and leaves the target [Sundered] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Rivet Popper
fusions.desc: A jab of your thumb-claw at a seam that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Lamellar Fold
fusions.desc: A barrier absorbs the next 22 damage for 8 seconds, and your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Rattled Loose
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 2% faster per stack (14% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour also rises by 5%.
